interpretation: A frozen replay diagnostic on the 492,751 learner: on each included row the same prepared input, context, state and current token give the prediction with the path and without it. Cancellation alone is not evidence of a defect; the paired error difference and the pooled ratios over the same rows' no-change error say whether the path improved or worsened the combined prediction on these rows. It does not reconstruct the 492,700 stop.
